slot.brief: Given wave equation y = A sin(kx − ωt), read amplitude, frequency, wavelength, and wave speed

stem: A transverse wave is described by $y(x,t)=0.03\sin(2\pi x-4\pi t)$, where $x$ and $y$ are in metres and $t$ is in seconds. Which set gives its amplitude, frequency, wavelength and speed, respectively?

verdicts.working: From y=A sin(kx−ωt): A=0.03 m, k=2π m⁻¹, and ω=4π s⁻¹. Thus λ=2π/k=1 m, f=ω/(2π)=2 Hz, and v=ω/k=2 m s⁻¹.

working:
$A=0.03\ \text{m},\quad k=2\pi\ \text{rad m}^{-1},\quad \omega=4\pi\ \text{rad s}^{-1}$
$f=\dfrac{\omega}{2\pi}=2\ \text{Hz}$
$\lambda=\dfrac{2\pi}{k}=1\ \text{m}$
$v=\dfrac{\omega}{k}=2\ \text{m s}^{-1}$

Independent check: From y=A sin(kx−ωt): A=0.03 m, k=2π m⁻¹, and ω=4π s⁻¹. Thus λ=2π/k=1 m, f=ω/(2π)=2 Hz, and v=ω/k=2 m s⁻¹.
solution:
Comparing with $y=A\sin(kx-\omega t)$ gives $A=0.03\ \text{m}$, $k=2\pi\ \text{m}^{-1}$ and $\omega=4\pi\ \text{s}^{-1}$.
$$f=\frac{\omega}{2\pi}=2\ \text{Hz},\qquad \lambda=\frac{2\pi}{k}=1\ \text{m},\qquad v=\frac{\omega}{k}=2\ \text{m s}^{-1}$$
Hence the set is $(0.03\ \text{m},\ 2\ \text{Hz},\ 1\ \text{m},\ 2\ \text{m s}^{-1})$.
